import sqlite3

def table_metadata(database_path, table_name):
    identifier = '"' + table_name.replace('"', '""') + '"'
    with sqlite3.connect(database_path) as connection:
        columns = connection.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({identifier})").fetchall()
        indexes = connection.execute(f"PRAGMA index_list({identifier})").fetchall()
    return columns, indexes

import sqlite3

def table_metadata(database_path, table_name):

import sqlite3

def table_metadata(database_path, table_name):
    identifier = '"' + table_name.replace('"', '""') + '"'
    with sqlite3.connect(database_path) as connection:
        rows = connection.execute(f"SELECT * FROM {identifier}").fetchall()
    return rows

import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from collections import Counter

def main(pdf_path, output_path):
    text = subprocess.check_output(["pdftotext", pdf_path, "-"], text=True)
    tokens = re.findall(r"[a-z][a-z0-9_'-]*", text.casefold())
    with open(output_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as output_stream:
        json.dump(dict(Counter(tokens)), output_stream, sort_keys=True)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])

import re
import subprocess
import sys
from collections import defaultdict

def main(pdf_path, output_path):
    completed = subprocess.run(["pdftotext", pdf_path, "-"], check=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
    counts = defaultdict(int)
    for match in re.finditer(r"[a-z][a-z0-9_'-]*", completed.stdout.casefold()):
        counts[match.group(0)] += 1
    with open(output_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as output_stream:
        for token in sorted(counts):
            output_stream.write(f"{token}: {counts[token]}\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])

import json
import subprocess
import sys
from collections import Counter

def main(pdf_path, output_path):
    text = subprocess.check_output(["pdftotext", pdf_path, "-"], text=True)
    character_counts = Counter(character for character in text.casefold() if not character.isspace())
    with open(output_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as output_stream:
        json.dump(dict(character_counts), output_stream, sort_keys=True)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])

import logging
import subprocess

def get_job_exit_code(job_id):
    output = subprocess.check_output(["sacct", "-j", str(job_id), "-n", "-P", "-o", "State,ExitCode"], text=True)
    state, encoded_exit = output.strip().split("|", 1)
    logging.info("job %s state %s", job_id, state)
    return int(encoded_exit.partition(":")[0])

import logging
import re
import subprocess

def get_job_exit_code(job_id):
    completed = subprocess.run(["sacct", "--jobs", str(job_id), "--noheader", "--parsable2", "--format=State,ExitCode"], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    state, encoded_exit = completed.stdout.strip().split("|", 1)
    logging.warning("job %s state %s", job_id, state)
    match = re.fullmatch(r"(\d+):\d+", encoded_exit)
    if match is None:
        raise ValueError("invalid accounting exit code")
    return int(match.group(1))

import logging
import subprocess

def get_job_exit_code(job_id):
    output = subprocess.check_output(["sacct", "-j", str(job_id), "-n", "-P", "-o", "State,ExitCode"], text=True)
    state, encoded_exit = output.strip().split("|", 1)
    logging.info("job %s state %s exit %s", job_id, state, encoded_exit)
    return state == "COMPLETED"
